object.name: evi.4wave~
object.digest: Simultaneous antialiased Saw, Rect, Tri and Sine oscillators
object.description: Phase synchronous shared frequency oscillators with simultaneous Saw, Rect, Tri and Sine outputs. Antialiasing method is 4-point polyblep.

inlets.description: Reset is naive and not antialiased.

outlets.description: Antialiased Saw oscillator in sync with other outputs
Antialiased Rect oscillator in sync with other outputs
Antialiased Tri oscillator in sync with other outputs
Antialiased Sine oscillator in sync with other outputs, the sine is not pure and has an additional harmonic.
Phase of oscillators for synchronising processes downstream.

attributes.name: zerosync
attributes.description: If on, tri phase is aligned at zero crossings with the other three oscillators. If off (slightly cheaper) tri phase is at the peak of the tri shape.
